client.binary: mysql  Ver 8.0.45 for macos26.2 on arm64 (Homebrew)
client.note: MySQLConnection.run: --batch --skip-column-names --silent plus the charset flags; calls whose "flags" is ["--comments"] are the perf_common.Reader path. Output is the exact stdout text (tab-separated, \n-escaped values, no header row). SHOW PRIVILEGES columns: Privilege, Context, Comment. SHOW DATABASES column: Database.

scenario: databases shop (table orders, procedure p, function f), db_x, dbAx; acct_low SELECT ON shop.*; acct_admin ALL ON *.* WITH GRANT OPTION; root is the image default.
